Respondents  (R4 impleaded as per order dated 09.12.2014 in M.P.No.2 of 2014 in  W.P.No.35070 of 2013)
 Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution   praying to issue a Writ of Certiorari, to call for the records rela  proceedings of the 3rd respondent in R.No. 110911/ E5/ A4/2013 date  18.12.2013 and subsequent proceedings issued by the 2nd respondent   R.No.1388/2012 / S1/ FSSA dated 19.12.2013 and to quash the same.
For R1 to R3 : Mr.E.Sundaram  Government Advocate  For R4 : Mr.K.Srinivasamoorthy  for M/s.Row & Reddy  ORDER

It is represented by Mr.S.Nedunchezhiyan, learned counsel for the petitioner that subsequent to filing of the present writ petition, the respondents have issued another proceedings vide https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 21/08/2025 04:02:25 pm )
R.No.110911/E5/A4/2013 dated 13.08.2015, cancelling the orders dated 18.12.2013, which is impugned in the present writ petition.
By virtue of the said proceedings, the relief sought in this writ petition has become infructuous.
2. In the light of the above, this writ petition is closed as infructuous.

Consequently,
connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
